mapper.select: SELECT BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING.BUSI_NO busiNo, BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING.BUSI_TABLE busiTable, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.trade_id tradeId, PTL_TRADE.busi_table plBusiTable, PTL_TRADE.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.totle_trade_id totleTradeId FROM FIN_PRODUCT INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_PRODUCT.finprod_id = FIN_CASH_INFO.finprod_id AND FIN_CASH_INFO.finprod_type = #{finprodType} AND FIN_CASH_INFO.cash_type_2 = #{cashTypeC02} INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE ON FIN_CASH_INFO.cash_id = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.cash_id AND FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.eff_date < STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.pay_cycle = #{BONUS_RULE_07} AND FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TYPE = #{BONUS_MODE_02} INNER JOIN ( select FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.cash_id, MAX(FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.eff_date) max_eff_date from FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE where FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.eff_date < STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') group by FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.cash_id )t2 ON FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.cash_id = t2.cash_id AND FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.eff_date = t2.max_eff_date INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.finprod_id = FIN_PRODUCT.finprod_id AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.busi_type = #{BUSI_TYPE_21} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.finprod_type2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.ps = #{PS_C10} AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TRADE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') INNER JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.trade_id = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.trade_id AND TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD.gen_type = #{CREATE_TYPE_03} INNER JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL ON TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.totle_trade_id = TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.TOTLE_TRADE_ID INNER JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL ON PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.totle_trade_id = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.totle_trade_id INNER JOIN PTL_TRADE ON PTL_TRADE.busi_no = TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL.totle_trade_id INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING ON TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL.trade_id = BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING.busi_no AND BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING.busi_table = #{BUSI_TABLE_02} INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL ON BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL.busi_no = BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING.busi_no AND BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL.busi_table = BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING.busi_table WHERE FIN_PRODUCT.profit_type = #{PROFIT_TYPE_03}

SELECT FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FIN_PRODUCT.CCY ccy, FIN_PRODUCT.P_FINPROD_ID pFinprodId, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.portfolio_id portfolioId, BOK_BOOKSET.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, BOK_POSITION_PRD.tdy_unpaid_intincexp tdyUnpaidIntincexp FROM FIN_PRODUCT INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ON FIN_PRODUCT.finprod_id = FIN_PRODUCT_ADD.finprod_id INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO ON FIN_PRODUCT.finprod_id = FIN_CASH_INFO.finprod_id AND FIN_CASH_INFO.finprod_type = #{finprodType} AND FIN_CASH_INFO.cash_type_2 = #{cashTypeC02} INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE ON FIN_CASH_INFO.cash_id = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.cash_id AND FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.eff_date < STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.pay_cycle = #{BONUS_RULE_07} AND FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TYPE = #{BONUS_MODE_02} INNER JOIN (select FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.cash_id, MAX(FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.eff_date) max_eff_date from FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE where FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.eff_date < STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') group by FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.cash_id) t2 ON FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.cash_id = t2.cash_id AND FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.eff_date = t2.max_eff_date INNER JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRD ON FIN_PRODUCT.finprod_id = BOK_POSITION_PRD.finprod_id AND BOK_POSITION_PRD.cdate = STR_TO_DATE(#{ystDate},'%Y-%m-%d') LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET ON BOK_BOOKSET.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PRD_VAL_PARAM ON PRD_VAL_PARAM.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID where FIN_PRODUCT.profit_type = #{PROFIT_TYPE_03} AND FIN_PRODUCT.vdate <= STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND FIN_PRODUCT.actmdate > STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND (BOK_POSITION_PRD.tdy_unpaid_intincexp > 0 OR ( PRD_VAL_PARAM.DEAL_LOSS_MODE = #{LOSS_HANDLE_MODE_01} AND BOK_POSITION_PRD.tdy_unpaid_intincexp < 0 ))
